title: Simple Expense Tracker Google Sheets, Daily Spending Log, Monthly Spending Tracker, Budget Tracker Spreadsheet, Money Tracker for Phone
desc:
Simple Expense Tracker for Google Sheets: the fastest way to log what you spend. Tap Add an entry on your phone, type the amount and pick a category. The tracker adds it all up: what you've spent this month, where it went, your daily average and how it compares with last month.

You get a PDF with links to your own Google Sheet (a blank copy and a filled-in example). Log on your phone in the free Google Sheets app, look back on a laptop. Not for Excel or Apple Numbers, and not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap the link and press "Make a copy". Nothing is shipped.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start Here: set up in 3 easy steps
• Setup: your name, currency, an optional monthly spending limit and 12 categories you can rename, plus 3 of your own
• Spending Log: phone-sized, room for 1,500 spends. Add an entry jumps to the next empty row, so no scrolling. Date, amount, category and a note if you like
• This Month (for your phone): spent so far, what's left of your limit, today, per day, on pace for, vs this day last month, where it went, your biggest spends and the last 7 days
• Dashboard (for your laptop, one screen): pick any month and everything updates. Spent vs your limit, vs last month, daily average and entries, each with a mini chart. A day-by-day running total vs last month and your limit, a "where it went" donut, top categories vs last month, your biggest spends, key checks and a short "needs attention" list
• More from Kova: our other money trackers

WHY IT'S EASY
• Log a spend in seconds, no scrolling
• Everything else fills itself in
• A fair comparison: this month so far vs the same point last month
• Look back at any of the last 12 months
• Refund? Type a minus and it comes off that category
• Any currency: $, €, £, AED, CHF, CAD, AUD, ₹ or type your own

WANT A FULL BUDGET? This is a simple spending log. For a budget per category, bills you tick each month and savings goals, see our Monthly Budget Planner (same look). Search KovaStudioHQ on Etsy.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The photos show example data. Your blank copy starts empty
• It needs a free Google account. It does not work in Excel or Apple Numbers
• No bank connection. You type in what you spend
• This is a spending tracker, not financial advice
• For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file or link
• Digital file, so no returns, but message us and we'll help with anything

Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
